answer: A5 is a typed work-unit queue on an append-only JSONL ledger. Three dispatcher adapters (local, worktree, cloud) compare-and-append a CLAIM record whose named fields are claim_id, fencing_token, lease_until_ns and dedupe_key; fcntl.LOCK_EX serializes the append so two dispatchers racing the same unit produce exactly one WON. Delivery is at-least-once plus idempotent units: exactly-once is not claimed, because a crash after a side effect and before COMPLETE still re-dispatches. A unit is idempotent iff two executions with the same idempotence_key yield the same CRLF-normalized artifact sha256; the architecture-dossier emit shape on this tree is NON-IDEMPOTENT (wall-clock ended_at) and MUST be skipped after SUCCEEDED rather than re-run. ONE completion reducer is TST-0003.evaluate — imported, not copied. Dynamic fan-out width comes from agentspec.resolve_dynamic_fanout on a schema-validated producer receipt. Barriers are per-unit timeouts (IsolatedPipelineRunner), not join-all. The FIRST construct that is not expressible is dispatcher-local SUCCESS from process exit code 0.

barriers.negative_control: CoupledBarrierRunner join-all with no per-unit timeout

claim_mechanism.dedupe_key: default unit_id; exactly one live CLAIM
claim_mechanism.fencing_token: monotonic per dedupe_key, assigned under LOCK_EX
claim_mechanism.lease_until_ns: CLAIM expires; unit returns to QUEUED
claim_mechanism.name: ledger CLAIM compare-and-append

delivery_guarantee.claimed: at-least-once plus idempotent units (skip-if-complete for NON-IDEMPOTENT shapes). exactly-once is not claimed.
delivery_guarantee.idempotence_criterion: A unit is idempotent iff two executions with the same idempotence_key produce the same CRLF-normalized sha256 of its primary artifact. Otherwise it is NON-IDEMPOTENT and a SUCCEEDED ledger state makes a later CLAIM return SKIP.

mechanism.serialization: fcntl.LOCK_EX compare-and-append on the ledger file
mechanism.stale_complete: COMPLETE whose fencing_token does not match the active CLAIM is CLAIM_DENIED
mechanism.winner: lowest seq among unexpired CLAIM records for that dedupe_key

delivery_guarantee.why_not_exactly_once: Three substrates cannot share a single atomic commit. A crash after the worker's side effect and before the COMPLETE record is durable re-enqueues the unit when the lease expires. That is at-least-once.

worktree.isolation: disjoint git indexes; teardown refused unless content preserved

ledger_schema.description: Every record is an append. In-place edit is detected by recomputing sha256 over (prev_sha256 + canonical payload). Delivery is at-least-once plus idempotent units; the exclusive-execution mechanism is the CLAIM record's (dedupe_key, fencing_token, lease_until_ns) triple under fcntl.LOCK_EX compare-and-append, not an asserted exactly-once property.

claim_id.description: Opaque id of one CLAIM attempt. Named exclusive-execution mechanism together with fencing_token and lease_until_ns.

dedupe_key.description: Exactly one live CLAIM per dedupe_key. Default equals unit_id. Named in this schema; not a prose guarantee.

fencing_token.description: Monotonic per dedupe_key. A COMPLETE/FAIL whose fencing_token does not match the active CLAIM is ignored.

idempotence_key.description: Stable key for at-least-once replay. Same key must not produce a second side-effecting execution after SUCCEEDED.

lease_until_ns.description: CLAIM is active until this monotonic-ish epoch ns. Expiry returns the unit to QUEUED.

ledger_schema.title: A5 append-only resumable work-unit ledger record

lifecycle.derived_from: ledger replay; file mtime is never a stall signal

negative_controls.description: A skill whose completion is process exit code 0 must be INEXPRESSIBLE; skill.council must stay EXPRESSIBLE.
Two threads claim the same unit_id: exactly one WON. Two distinct unit_ids: both WON. Re-claim after COMPLETE: SKIP.

precedence.duplicate_in_one_file: FAIL-CLOSED: a second ENQUEUE for the same unit_id appends ENQUEUE_DUP with result=SKIP and does not create a second queue row.
precedence.loader: JSONL append + hash-chain verify + CLAIM compare-and-append. No evaluator besides the shared reducer.
precedence.merge: No field-level merge of ledger records. Records are immutable. An in-place edit is detected when sha256 != sha256(prev_sha256 + canonical payload).
precedence.reducer_copy: FAIL-CLOSED. A local evaluate() that is not TST-0003.evaluate is a second control plane.
precedence.rule: Ledger seq is the only order. A later file or dispatcher never overrides an earlier seq. When two CLAIM records share a dedupe_key, the lowest seq whose lease has not expired is active.
precedence.tie_break: Equal fencing_token cannot occur: tokens are assigned under LOCK_EX as max(existing)+1. Equal seq cannot occur: seq is len(rows)+1 under the same lock. No mtime, no wall clock, no runtime coin-flip.
precedence.unlisted_file: A dispatcher adapter absent from MANIFEST.json is not loaded.

question: Specify a distributed workflow-runtime: a typed work-unit queue with an append-only resumable ledger, dispatchers for local / worktree / cloud substrates, barriers, dynamic fan-out and ONE shared completion reducer. Define the unit lifecycle states, the ledger record, and state precisely which delivery guarantee is claimed - exactly-once, or at-least-once plus idempotent units - and what makes a unit idempotent.
